verdict.rationale: dltHub offers pipeline health monitoring, run logging, and scheduling via its CLI/Web UI (dlt-docs-15, dlt-docs-26, dlt-docs-59, dlt-docs-70), which touches on observability of pipeline runs, but there is no explicit documentation of a table 'freshness' metric or an alert specifically triggered when a pipeline misses its expected cadence/SLA. Missing for 10: per-table freshness/staleness indicators, explicit cadence-miss alerting or SLA breach notifications, and independent confirmation that these monitoring features work as described.
